item.title: Between Worlds and Chemical Certainties: Jade Ring Confronts the Modern Condition on Debut Album “Pills”
item.description: There is something quietly radical about a masked figure stepping forward in an age of algorithmic spectacle to say: this was made by a human. item.description: For centuries, the forbidden fruit has stood as a symbol of temptation, transgression and the painful realization that some decisions do not merely alter a single moment, but entire lives.
